subject: MAP preflight: alignment checkpoint for ProtonHealth evaluation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP preflight: alignment checkpoint for ProtonHealth evaluation

Team —

We have our internal pre-kickoff for ProtonHealth tomorrow. I pulled a first-pass MAP and attached a draft (MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx) plus the evaluation checklist that the product team will use. High level ask: I want a short alignment thread where we confirm roles, outstanding dependencies, and the timeline to close (they're targeting end of Feb).

Please review and weigh in on three items by EOD today:
1) RACI — confirm who owns each row in the MAP. I put tentative owners in column G.
2) Tech blockers — flagged in the infra tab. Dev, can you confirm whether the data access requirement (S3 + VPC peering) is realistic for a 2-week turnaround?
3) Evaluation constraints — Grace, confirm whether the checklist covers the clinical data sampling constraints they mentioned.

Quick notes: ProtonHealth is sensitive about audit logs and retention; security questionnaire in their packet focuses on KMS and event-level logs. We should propose a 90-day retention for eval runs and a follow-up for longer-term retention if they move to Dedicated.

Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (draft), evaluation_checklist.md, infra_requirements.pdf

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi

Thanks — I can own commercial and pricing. Two notes:
1) I have a calendar conflict during tomorrow morning's pre-kickoff; can we move to 11:00 PST? If not, I can send a brief note to the customer to say Marcus will lead tomorrow and I'll join the follow-up.
2) For the pricing ask: I'm comfortable offering a small evaluation credit tied to the MAP milestones (up to $6k) but want to keep any multi-month discounts off the table until after the evaluation completes and we have perf metrics.

Also, I reviewed the MAP and suggest a small wording change to the "success criteria" so it's explicit about latency SLOs and throughput minimums. I'll drop a comment in the doc.

Quick infra readout:
- VPC peering + S3 pull: doable in ~72-96 hours if ProtonHealth provides a security contact and VPC CIDR. If they require private IP access to our Dedicated nodes, that adds ~1 week for networking and testing.
- Audit logs: we can enable event-level logs for evaluation runs and export to their S3; retention configurable. See infra_requirements.pdf for details.
- I'll need an ops escalation contact (name + mobile) in the MAP so our on-call can coordinate any environment flakiness during tests.

Attached: infra_requirements.pdf (high-level runbook) and a short ops checklist.

Dev

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP preflight: alignment checkpoint for ProtonHealth evaluation

Thank you all — summary and next steps below.

Summary decisions (updated MAP attached):
- RACI: Commercial = Laura (owner), Sales Exec = Marcus (exec sponsor), Solutions = Irene (MAP owner / PM), Engineering = Dev (technical lead), Product = Grace (evaluation criteria).
- Timeline: Target close = 2027-02-28 conditional on access within 72 hours of kickoff. If access delayed beyond 72h, move target to 2027-03-15.
- Security: propose 90-day event log retention for eval; Legal to confirm for ProtonHealth but we will include data_handling_signoff milestone before infra spike.
- Credits: Laura to offer up to $6k evaluation credit tied to milestone completion; no multi-month discounts in the MAP.

Action items (owners):
- Laura: finalize commercial language + add pricing milestone in MAP (due: 2027-01-22).
- Dev: confirm ops escalation contact and update infra_requirements.pdf with exact runbook step IDs (due: 2027-01-21).
- Grace: finalize evaluation checklist and flag any PII/PHI constraints (due: 2027-01-22).
- Marcus: confirm kickoff time with ProtonHealth and if Laura can't make 10:00 PST, move to 11:00 PST (due: 2027-01-20 end of day).
- Irene: update MAP with RACI and push final to the shared drive + send to customer after internal sign-off (done).

I've uploaded the updated MAP to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2-map-protonhealth (MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx -> MAP_FINAL_v2.xlsx).

If no objections by 14:00 PST today, I'll send the internal MAP and the kickoff agenda to ProtonHealth and propose next steps.

Best —
Irene
